Why, with this bill o’ yourn, you’re tellin’ me a backwoods clinic with a space heater and a broken fax machine is gonna get the same payout as a full-service rural hospital that keeps the whole county breathin’? I mean that’s like payin’ the lemonade stand and the fire department the same rate ‘cause they both serve water — one just happens to do it when your roof’s on fire!

I say, if you listen real close, you can hear the champagne corks poppin’ at the Mar-A-Lardo fund raisers every time a rural ER shutters its doors.

Now don’t get me wrong — I admire an ol’ geezer like yourself tryin’ to cut waste, but when the only folks clappin’ are the Koch boys and hedge fund hyenas, it ain’t reform, it’s a heist in broad daylight with you at the wheel of the getaway car.
